trace-distillation.when: One recurring, evidence-linked failure suggests one small prompt, tool, or task-script repair.

population.when: Several complete alternatives can be compared with one frozen scalar outcome score.

pareto.when: Candidates have complementary case-level strengths; retain nondominated options before selecting one finalist.

sharedPolicy: Development-only mutation, reflection, ranking and operator attribution; one frozen finalist, one-way independent validation, optional later holdout; no automatic source activation.
operatorAdaptation: Use development-only parent/child deltas to write a next-study hypothesis. Require at least two distinct attributable child-parent comparisons per operator plus parent/task-family coverage before treating an operator as established. This local helper is not a trained optimizer.
